summary: Import-payload agentic escape hatch first slice (#622): write plan.json + PLAN.md + DRAFT_PR_BODY.md via --escape-hatch / --escape-hatch-on-conflict and MCP fields; rich human-review PR body sections; never auto-force high-value overwrites.
migration_impact: New optional CLI flags and MCP args on import-payload. On conflicts, agents should emit escape-hatch artifacts instead of improvising multi-turn cp. Draft PR open/worktree apply remain follow-ups; human approval still required for force overwrites.
migration_guidance: 2. On mature adoption with conflicts: gh plate import-payload --strategy conservative --escape-hatch-on-conflict --json.
3. Open a draft PR using DRAFT_PR_BODY.md when multi-file judgment is required.
4. Do not use --strategy force without explicit human approval on product-owned paths.
agent_notes: Escape hatch does not write payload files. Prefer conservative + escape hatch over force. Residual: automatic draft PR create + worktree apply (still human-gated). need:human-review on #622 reflects product human-judgment gate, not a block on shipping this surface.
